description: A chat workspace for many AI models, with agents, a knowledge base and plugins.

promotion.reason: Approved by the owner. Qualified as offered on 2026-09-12: a real install of LobeHub 2.2.17, upstream's current release proved it starts, opens to a first screen with a clear next step, survives a restart and a keep-data reinstall with its data and generated credentials intact, and removes everything it created. Local Store wrote this definition from the project's own deployment instructions.

risk_notes: Creates 4 Docker containers and publishes 2 ports on this computer's loopback interface only.
Its lobehub-store service answers on a second loopback address, which the app's own pages call directly. Local Store opens only the main one.
Generates 5 credentials of its own, keeps them beside the app's data, and reuses them if you reinstall.
Keeps its data in this app's managed folder. A keep-data uninstall leaves it; deleting data removes it permanently.
Proven on Windows with Docker's Linux engine. macOS and Linux hosts are unverified.
Written by Local Store from the project's own deployment instructions, not taken from an app store.
Asks you to create an account on first open; anyone who can reach the address can register one.
Uses the model providers you add keys for; the keys are stored encrypted with a key Local Store generated.
Files you upload go to a bundled RustFS object store, a 1.0 release candidate, on a second loopback address the page uploads to directly.
Its bucket is made by Local Store's start script with a signed S3 request, because MinIO has taken the mc client image upstream uses off Docker Hub.
Source-available under the LobeHub Community License, which restricts commercial derivative works.

config.content:
{
  "id": "lobehub",
  "name": "LobeHub",
  "version": "2.2.17",
  "source": "https://github.com/lobehub/lobehub",
  "website": "https://lobehub.com",
  "documentation": "https://lobehub.com/docs/self-hosting/platform/docker-compose",
  "short_desc": "A chat workspace for many AI models, with agents, a knowledge base and plugins.",
  "categories": [
    "Artificial Intelligence"
  ],
  "license": "LobeHub Community License",
  "form_fields": [
    {
      "type": "random",
      "label": "Database password",
      "min": 32,
      "max": 32,
      "env_variable": "LOBE_DB_PASSWORD"
    },
    {
      "type": "random",
      "label": "Key vault secret",
      "min": 32,
      "max": 32,
      "encoding": "base64",
      "env_variable": "LOBE_KEY_VAULTS_SECRET"
    },
    {
      "type": "random",
      "label": "Sign-in secret",
      "min": 32,
      "max": 32,
      "encoding": "base64",
      "env_variable": "LOBE_AUTH_SECRET"
    },
    {
      "type": "random",
      "label": "Object store access key",
      "min": 20,
      "max": 20,
      "env_variable": "LOBE_STORE_ACCESS_KEY"
    },
    {
      "type": "random",
      "label": "Object store secret key",
      "min": 40,
      "max": 40,
      "env_variable": "LOBE_STORE_SECRET_KEY"
    }
  ]
}
